title: Battle Athletess Daiundoukai
justification: The six OVA episodes, "Chronicle Beginning" (1997-05-25) to "Stage Yonder" (1998-06-25), are TVDB 72796 season 0 episodes 1-6 "Mission One, Chronicle Beginning" to "Mission Six, Stage Yonder" on the same dates; season 1 is the TV series "Battle Athletes Victory" (AniDB 504), where they fell by default. TVDB also lists the OVA as its own series 468318, a later duplicate; the node stays on 72796, which lists this AniDB id and carries the TV series too. On TMDB the OVA is 9407 "Battle Athletes" season 1 episodes 1-6, same titles and dates; TMDB 94196 is the TV series. The offset is stated as 0 so the season 0 placement is published.
